rules.summary: An abstraction must name a domain concept or have multiple real callers.
Keep one contract and one registry for each concept; derive consumers.
Use a domain noun such as bodyRequest or checkoutResponse instead of data, result, or temp.
Name business facts and branch with guards instead of nesting ternaries.
Compute complicated facts before branching and keep one fact per condition.
Default at input and configuration boundaries; do not hide missing internal state with fallback chains.
Keep Effect workflows intact and run network, filesystem, database, process, or browser work at visible edges.
Represent expected failures with tagged domain errors; leave defects as defects.
Parse untrusted input once with Effect Schema and pass trusted domain values internally.
Comments explain a business constraint, compatibility reason, or surprising decision.
Protect observable behavior before changing structure and test contracts instead of implementation shape.
